Headline: Community Weekly Activity: Referral Rush 🟩

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
🟩 Community Weekly Activity: Referral Rush 🟩
The more, the merrier! It’s time to bring your friends along to the KuCoin family and supercharge your points balance together! 🚀
Invite your friends to join our Telegram community, and you could walk away with a massive points boost!
## How to join:
1️⃣ Generate your unique referral link using /link command and invite your friends directly into the group.
2️⃣ Ensure your friends join the group and stay active!
3️⃣ The top referrers who bring in the most valid new members will claim the prize.
🏆 Reward: Top 3 referrers will earn 100 Points each!
📅 Winners announced every Monday.
Let’s grow the KuFamily together and secure those points! 🟩
